items.description:
User-centered design methodology for coding agents. Before you brainstorm solutions or write code, UX Superpowers guides you through structured UX discovery: identifying who you're building for (personas), what they're trying to accomplish (jobs-to-be-done), how they experience the problem today (user journey maps), and how you'll know if you succeeded (telemetry and success metrics). Accepts raw user research data (interviews,
surveys, support tickets, analytics) or guides discovery from scratch. Produces a UX Discovery Document that anchors all subsequent development. Currently ships 8 skills and works for any software type - web apps, CLIS, APIs, mobile, infrastructure, internal tools, games. Eventually there will be more skills that help in UX Discovery. Designed to complement the Superpowers plugin by owning the "what and why" before the "how".

items.name: vanikya-ai-mcp
items.description:
Vanikya AI MCP connects Claude Code to Vanikya AI platform, giving you image generation, SEO analysis, creative insights, and credits management all directly from Claude.
Generate stunning images, videos, vectors, and lottie animations using 16+ models including GPT-Image-1.5, Flux 2 Pro, and Google's Nano Banana. Run AI-powered SEO audits on any URL (single or batch). Get creative scoring and branding feedback on images. Check your credit balance and top up  without leaving your terminal.

Powered by an OAuth-authenticated MCP server with guided skills that handle the full workflow: prompt enhancement, credit estimation, generation, and polling.

items.name: vantage-critical-thinking-plugins
items.description: Five plugins that add reflective "why" layers to any AI output. Philosophy, History, Psychology, Sociology, and Rhetoric — each examines a question from a different vantage point. Includes a loyalty audit capability that detects whether recommendations are optimized for the user or the provider. 60 tools total. Designed to complement domain plugins (legal, finance, product, etc.) by surfacing hidden assumptions, historical precedent, behavioral barriers, power dynamics, and accountability language.

items.name: vaper
items.description: Status line widget that shows how much water you've boiled with Claude today by converting daily token usage into joules and milliliters of water heated from 20°C to 100°C.

items.name: vardoger
items.description:
vardoger personalizes Claude Code by analyzing your own conversation history and turning recurring patterns into tailored rules.

How it works: the plugin's `analyze` skill calls the `vardoger` CLI, which reads your local `~/.claude/projects/` session files in batches. Claude summarizes each batch for behavioral signals (tools you prefer, libraries you use, coding conventions you follow, mistakes you don't want repeated), then synthesizes the summaries into a single personalization that lands in your rules file. Re-running refreshes the personalization as your history grows.

Everything runs on your machine — conversations never leave your disk, there is no server or account, and the output is plain Markdown you can edit or delete. The same CLI also supports Cursor, Codex, and OpenClaw, so the personalization stays consistent across assistants if you use more than one.

items.name: varlock
items.description: Secure environment variable management with Varlock for secrets, API keys, credentials, and sensitive configuration.

items.name: varlock-skill
items.description: Secure environment variable management with schema validation and secret masking. Validates secrets are set correctly without exposing values in terminal output.

items.name: vault-pkm
items.description: Personal knowledge management for Claude Code. Connect to your Obsidian vault with 20 MCP tools, semantic search, wikilink graph traversal, template-based note creation, link health audits, and cross-session activity logging. Includes 3 autonomous agents and hooks for proactive knowledge capture.

items.name: vbnet-lsp-claude-plugin
items.description: vbnet-lsp adds Roslyn-powered VB.NET language intelligence to Claude Code through Language Server Protocol. It registers .vb files and launches vbnet-ls over stdio, enabling semantic diagnostics, completion, hover, definition/references navigation, and symbol-aware edits in VB.NET projects. The language server is distributed as the NuGet global tool DNAKode.VbNet.Lsp and validated in CI on Windows and Linux, including real Claude plugin validation and command checks.

items.name: vector-md-context-injector
items.description:
Vector-md-plugin provides hooks to automatically inject sub-tree scoped context files upon reading a file from said sub-tree. The injections are deduplicated per agent context. The skill file and CLAUDE.md loading hook provide guidance towards maintaining these files as a natural part of the work Claude Code does.

The idea is that these vector.md files form a knowledge graph that's automatically available to claude as needed.

items.name: velixar
items.description:
Velixar is a cognitive memory system for Claude Code. It gives Claude persistent memory, a knowledge graph, identity awareness, contradiction detection, and belief tracking across every session, not just
session logs, but a full reasoning layer.

6 skills, 1 agent, 40 MCP tools, 5 live resources, and 18 workflow prompts. Claude doesn't just remember what you said, it understands how your decisions evolved, detects when new information contradicts stored knowledge, and maintains a persistent model of who you are and how you work.

items.name: vellum
items.description: Local design-iteration skill — self-hosted alternative to SuperDesign. Iterates static HTML/CSS mockups using your real Tailwind tokens and shadcn/ui class vocabulary.

items.name: velt
items.description: Add real-time collaboration to any React or Next.js app. AI-guided setup with codebase analysis, best-practice rules, and MCP-powered tooling for the Velt SDK. Includes commands for comments, presence, cursors, CRDT collaborative editing, and notifications.

items.name: venture-capital-intelligence
items.description: 9 skills for venture capital intelligence. 3 run on pure Claude reasoning. 6 run Claude + Python for deterministic outputs — screening startups, modeling financials, sizing markets, computing cap table waterfalls, scanning deal signals, and generating LP fund reports. Built from the best open-source VC tools.

items.name: verifiedx
items.description: VerifiedX helps Claude install and verify action protection in existing AI systems with minimal code changes. It inspects a repo, detects the smallest real integration seam such as OpenAI Agents, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph, direct model clients, MCP, raw runtimes, lower seams, or explicit wrappers, then applies the minimal VerifiedX patch without redesigning the system. VerifiedX blocks unjustified high impact actions before execution while letting the workflow continue through the right path. It can also audit an existing integration and point out missing pieces or unnecessary complexity.

items.name: version-sentinel
items.description: Hard-blocks dependency additions, bumps, and downgrades until a fresh, source-cited version check is recorded via WebSearch. Supports npm, pip, Cargo, and NuGet ecosystems. Uses PreToolUse hooks to intercept manifest edits and install commands, blocking them until the developer verifies the latest version upstream.

items.name: versori-skills
items.description:
The versori-skills plugin gives Claude Code the ability to create, build, deploy, and monitor production-grade data integrations, entirely from the command line. Rather than stitching together simple automations, Versori enables Claude to build complex, multi-workflow integrations with full TypeScript control using the versori-run SDK.

The plugin follows a research-first approach: before writing any code, Claude gathers and structures API documentation for each system involved, producing a grounded research document that becomes the single source of truth for the integration. This ensures generated code is accurate and well-informed rather than hallucinated.

From there, Claude manages the full integration lifecycle: bootstrapping projects, configuring systems and connections, generating type-safe TypeScript workflows, running local validation via Deno, and deploying to production with built-in safety checks like dry-run previews and project context validation.

Key features:

- Research-grounded code generation: Claude researches API documentation before writing code, with every fact linked to its source. Research documents are uploaded as project assets so future modifications retain full context.
- Full project lifecycle management: Create, sync, deploy, version, promote, and rollback integrations without leaving the terminal. Supports multiple environments with version promotion between them.
- Complex multi-workflow integrations: Build integrations with scheduled ETL pipelines, webhook handlers, durable long-running workflows, and stateful batch processing using KV storage, going well beyond the simple trigger-action automations of platforms.
- Embedded integrations (multi-user): Supports user activations and connection management for embedded integration scenarios where end-users bring their own credentials.
- Secure credential handling: Credentials are referenced as environment variables and resolved at runtime. They are never embedded in commands or stored in code.
- Built-in deployment safety: Dry-run mode for all destructive operations.

items.name: very-good-ai-flutter-plugin
items.description:
Production-quality Flutter and Dart skills from Very Good Ventures. Provides opinionated, best-practice guidance for accessibility (WCAG 2.1), BLoC state management, testing
(unit, widget, golden), Material 3 theming, GoRouter navigation, internationalization, layered architecture, static security (OWASP Mobile Top 10), and license compliance — plus
automated dart analyze and dart format hooks that run after every code edit. Skills activate automatically based on context or via slash commands.

items.name: vibe-cartographer
items.description: Vibe Cartographer turns the vibe-coding hype into a structured workflow. Eight commands walk you from idea spark to shipped app: a flipped-interaction onboarding (/onboard), a scope brainstorm (/scope), a PRD interview (/prd), a tech spec grounded in your architecture (/spec), a dependency-aware build checklist (/checklist), an autonomous-or-step-by-step build loop (/build), an optional polish pass (/iterate), and a real retrospective (/reflect). The agent picks up a unified builder profile at ~/.claude/profiles/builder.json so persona, pacing, and stack preferences carry across projects and across other 626Labs plugins. Three Level-3.5 self-evolution commands round it out: /evolve (the plugin reads its own logs and proposes improvements), /vitals (self-diagnostic health check), /friction (real-time friction capture for future evolve cycles).

items.name: vibe-coding
items.description: Schema-first architecture discipline for AI-assisted development. Enforces tables → RLS → features ordering, generates paste-ready Claude Code prompts, and manages build queue batches. Built from the methodology behind a 511-table production app with 1,016 security policies.

items.name: vibe-doc
items.description: Vibe Doc is an AI-powered documentation gap analyzer for any codebase. It scans your project's artifacts, classifies the project type (web app, API, data pipeline, Claude Code plugin, etc.), measures coverage against a tier-appropriate documentation matrix, and either generates the missing docs from your existing artifacts or hands you a ranked list of gaps to close. Five slash commands cover the loop: /vibe-doc:scan (analyze), /vibe-doc:generate (write missing docs), /vibe-doc:check (CI deployment-readiness gate), /vibe-doc:status (snapshot), and /vibe-doc:evolve (Level-3 self-improvement — the plugin reads its own session logs and proposes SKILL improvements). Honest about coverage: no cherry-picked denominators, no false negatives the matcher has learned to flag.

items.name: vibe-flow
items.description: Orchestration skills for Vibe Kanban. Turn a spec into merged code using multi-agent waves: plan → ship → link → review → merge, with autonomous fix loops. Supports parallel wave dispatch, executor tier routing (T0 flash → T4 opus), board status transitions, and cost budgets.

items.name: vibe-iterate
items.description: Post-ship product iteration for Claude Code. Pick a banner mode — feature-add, competitive, ux-polish, or bug-bash — or reach for a sidecar (radar, spy, scan-releases, rate, ship, upgrade). Every run ships one PR, regression-aware and small-diff-preferred. The agent keeps an "Atlas" of what you've shipped, considered, and cut across sessions, and stays current on your stack via context7 plus a weekly framework-release scan. Composes with vibe-cartographer when it's installed; works standalone when it isn't. No telemetry — Atlas data stays local.

items.name: vibe-keystone
items.description: Vibe Keystone bootstraps a CLAUDE.md for any repository — the load-bearing structural file every agent decision in that repo will rest on. Unlike a generic template, Keystone interviews the user for org / decision surface / voice rules / persona before drafting, so the produced file reflects YOUR conventions, not 626Labs defaults baked in. Tenant-aware: detects the repo type from filesystem signals (code platform / marketing site / long-form writing / mixed) and adapts the produced CLAUDE.md to the right shape. Use when starting a new repo or when an existing CLAUDE.md is stale. The keystone is what every other Claude Code workflow rests on; investing 5 minutes here saves agent-confusion across hundreds of future sessions in the repo.

items.name: vibe-replay
items.description: Turn AI coding sessions into shareable, interactive replays. Auto-generates GitHub PR artifacts (markdown + animated GIF), self-contained HTML replays, and session analytics. Supports Claude Code and Cursor.

items.name: vibe-taker
items.description: Move a feature between repos without copy-paste archaeology. vibe-taker captures a feature out of one codebase as a portable bundle — architecture sketch, contract surface, the AI prompts that built it, a verbatim source snapshot, and the gotchas — then plants it into another repo with stack-aware adaptation. It reads source autonomously and only asks you when the WHY can't be derived from the code; on plant it detects the target's stack and picks code-lift on a high match, spec-driven re-implementation on a low one, or declines a hard cross-language mismatch — always with a diff you confirm before anything is written. Three commands: capture, plant, list. Local-only by default; ~/.vibe-taker/library/ is the single source of truth.

items.name: vibe-test
items.description: Test coverage for vibe-coded apps that actually matters. vibe-test reads your app, classifies it by type and deployment risk, and generates tests proportional to that risk — not a boilerplate dump, not a pass/fail meter. It catches the broken harnesses other tools assume away: runners that silently report 0%, missing test binaries, coverage cherry-picked over a fraction of your files. Seven commands cover audit, generate, fix, coverage, gate, and posture, and the handoff artifacts (test plan, runbook, CI stub) survive uninstalling the plugin. JS/TS today.

items.name: vibe-thesis
items.description: Academic thesis authoring in Claude Code. vibe-thesis scaffolds and co-authors thesis-shaped artifacts — dissertations, master's theses, long-form research articles, position essays — with a rendered PDF skeleton in about 30 minutes. Its voice pipeline captures whose prose anchors your writing and applies it to drafts without changing your claims, while a tone lint catches the inflationary, self-praising patterns LLM-assisted academic writing tends to accumulate. Six commands: render, status, voice, guard, smooth, audit.

items.name: vibecircle
items.description: See what your friends are building. A social feed for friend groups who vibe code — share screenshots, deploy links, and coding activity with your circle. Features: auto-capture from Claude Code via /share command, live app embeds, reactions and comments, ambient presence (see who's building right now), and AI-powered project explanations (BYOK). Includes /circle setup for zero-friction device code authentication, and /share for posting updates. Open source, MIT licensed.

items.name: vibeguard
items.description: Security auditor and hardener for vibe-coded projects. 170+ vulnerability checks across 24 categories including injection, XSS, auth bypass, IDOR, Supabase RLS, prompt injection, exposed secrets, rate limiting, CORS, and auth provider misconfigs. Three commands: /vibeguard:audit (scan and report), /vibeguard:fix (patch findings), /vibeguard:harden (add security infrastructure). Includes a pre-commit hook that blocks git commits containing hardcoded secrets.

items.name: vibekanban
items.description:
VibeKanban is a dev progress kanban board that runs entirely inside Claude Code. When you code with Claude, every task is automatically tracked — started, completed, and reported — on a local kanban board with a browser-based UI.

No cloud service, no sign-up, no npm install. Just a Python server on localhost and a single HTML file. Claude creates tasks when you ask for work, moves them through columns as progress happens, records git diff stats on completion, and writes work reports you can review later in the web UI.

Multi-project support lets you manage several codebases from one board. Switch between projects with tabs, drag cards between columns, and view completed work grouped by date, category, or development phase.

items.name: vibelearn
items.description: VibeLearn silently watches your Claude Code sessions, extracts the concepts you encounter while building, and turns them into personalized quiz questions — so you actually retain what you learn. After each session, run `vl quiz` to review with adaptive spaced repetition across 7 question formats (multiple choice, spot the bug, code reading, fill in the blank, open-ended, true/false, ordering). Difficulty adjusts automatically: 3 correct answers in a row promotes you to the next level, one wrong answer drops you back. Senior-level open-ended answers are evaluated by a 5-dimension AI rubric.

items.name: vibesurfer
items.description:
A real browser for your local AI agent. Native WebKit on macOS, WebKitGTK on Linux, WebView2 on Windows,
with a wire protocol designed for LLMs instead of for humans staring at DevTools. Login once, scrape
JS-rendered pages, fill forms, take screenshots, drive your own app for smoke tests.

items.name: vibiz
items.description: Generate ads, funnels, ICPs, social posts, and full Meta campaigns from inside Claude Code. Drafts a marketing post about every commit you make.

items.name: video-library-classifier
items.description: A Claude Code / Cowork plugin for videographers who need to organize large libraries of footage before editing in Final Cut Pro.

items.name: video-to-code-skill
items.description: Inputs the content of any video into Claude Code prompt / context window as a multimodal bundle of voice transcription and data summary, time synced with keyframes - screenshots of key moments from the video so it can be used for all further requests related to that content.

items.name: videozero
items.description: Generate 2D animations and full explainer videos with VideoZero.  Create engaging kinetic typography, illustrative charts, or animate complex algorithms and fomula.

items.name: viral-launch-pipeline
items.description: A 21-agent orchestrator for viral product launches. One skill coordinates parallel web research (YouTube, X, Reddit, industry), manager-critiqued hook and giveaway writing, a body specialist chain (weapons, controversy, technical, flow), a Mom Test for mass-market readability, and multi-channel delivery (X-thread, LinkedIn post, ProductHunt copy). Manager loops force rewrites until the rubric passes, with a full paper trail and resumable state.

items.name: virtual-team
items.description:
Virtual Team turns Claude Code into a roster of 12 senior specialists you can summon by slash command. Instead of one generic assistant trying to be everything at once, you get focused expert mindsets — a backend engineer who actually thinks about input validation and authorization, a database engineer who asks about access patterns before suggesting indexes, a security engineer who threat-models the diff in front of them, a QA engineer who builds a test strategy before writing a single test. Each persona ships with a repeatable workflow and a
 structured output contract so the answers are scannable, prioritized, and actionable — not freeform prose you have to parse.

 The plugin is project-adaptive: every persona detects your stack (language, framework, package manager, conventions, existing patterns) at invocation time, so the same
 /virtual-team:frontend call gives sharp React advice in a React repo and sharp Svelte advice in a Svelte repo, with no per-project configuration. A shared review rubric and ecosystem context layer keeps recommendations grounded in real-world tradeoffs rather than textbook generalities.

Two meta-commands tie the roster together. /virtual-team:senior-brother is your generalist mentor — bring it anything, even a half-formed thought, and it figures out what you actually need, gives you the better solution, and tells you what you're lacking and how to level up. /virtual-team:all is the parallel orchestrator — point it at a PR or a feature and it
 dispatches every relevant specialist simultaneously, then synthesizes their findings into one prioritized report with a clear ship/hold verdict.

Who it's for: indie developers and small teams who don't have a full senior bench in-house; senior engineers who want a structured second opinion before merging; anyone who's tired of the same generic AI suggestions and wants opinionated, role-specific expertise. version 3.0.0, actively maintained at github.com/Apoorve8055/virtual-team.

Supports desktop, mobile, and full-page captures.

items.description: Its a full packs of command, skill, hook and mcp

Voltaire connects Stripe data, installs behavioral tracking into the codebase, and runs three AI agents on every /voltaire: timing analysis, cohort comparison, and churn tracking to surface where conversion is being lost and what to fix.

items.name: voxflow
items.description: AI voice CLI bundled as 5 skills (hub, podcast, transcribe, video, slice). Synthesize speech in 200+ voices across 40+ languages, generate multi-speaker AI podcasts from a topic or URL, transcribe audio/video with word-level timestamps, dub video from SRT subtitles, run end-to-end video translation, and turn long articles into vertical card video reels via Remotion. Backed by a hosted TTS/ASR/LLM/render service with per-user quota (free tier 10K/mo).

Includes 6 skills: health-check, log-analysis, backup-check, redirect, site-health, and wp-audit.

items.description:
Vue 3 LSP plugin for Claude Code. Combines vue-language-server (Volar v3) with typescript-language-server into a single LSP server, providing full TypeScript intelligence for .vue files — hover,
go-to-definition, references, document symbols, call hierarchy, diagnostics, completions, and rename.

items.name: vulca
items.description: Vulca adds agent-native visual workflows to Claude Code: visual discovery, brainstorm/spec/plan artifacts, structured prompt composition, semantic layer decomposition, and L1-L5 cultural evaluation. It is designed for reviewable image work instead of one-shot prompting, with local-first defaults and explicit opt-in for provider-backed generation, editing, and evaluation.

items.description: Verify AI-generated STEM claims against curated knowledge bases, IEEE standards, and mathematical checks. VVUQ4AI runs physics constants, dimensional analysis, and standards compliance checks (IEEE 802.3, NSF Biosketch) on claims Claude generates or encounters, returning structured verdicts with confidence scores.

items.name: vynn
items.description:
Self-improving AI workflows & backtesting. Run backtests, optimize prompts, manage
workflows, and set up schedules directly in Claude Code.

items.name: waggle
items.description: Waggle is a search engine for AI agents that implement Google's A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol. This plugin lets Claude discover agents by capability and invoke them directly from your conversation.

items.name: warmysender
items.description: Cold email campaigns, email warmup, LinkedIn outreach, and 20M+ B2B lead database. Connect your WarmySender account to Claude via remote MCP server with OAuth 2.1. Manage campaigns, prospects, mailboxes, warmup settings, LinkedIn sequences, and suppression lists through natural language.

items.name: watch-video
items.description:
watch-video gives Claude eyes and ears for any video — local files, public URLs (YouTube, Loom, Vimeo, TikTok, ~1,500 sites via yt-dlp), or Jira attachments fetched directly via API token. One command produces a complete evidence bundle: timestamped JPEG frames, a Whisper transcript (local faster-whisper or hosted Groq / OpenAI), optional OCR for on-screen text, and three report formats — report.md, self-contained report.html with base64-embedded frames, and corporate-friendly report.docx.

Key features:
- LLM-driven highlights: pass a prompt ("summarize the rate decision and inflation outlook", "identify the bug and when it occurs") and Claude picks the N most relevant moments with frame + reason + verbatim quote.
- Smart dedup with perceptual hash + transcript-aware protection: typically drops 40-60% of redundant frames on screen recordings without losing narrated moments.
- OCR for screen-recording UIs: Tesseract with 2x upscale + auto-invert + PSM 6, output to grep-able ocr.txt.
- Per-step content-hash cache: re-runs are nearly free.
- Opt-in Jira posting with a confirmation gate BEFORE any attachment upload — declining leaves the ticket untouched, no orphan state.
- Batch mode for sprint retros: process a JQL query's worth of bug tickets in one command.

items.name: waterfall
items.description: Multi-agent Specification-Driven Development (SDD) framework for Claude Code. Waterfall orchestrates a team of specialized agents (PM, OR, PO, TL, DV, RV, QA, DS) through a strict waterfall workflow — from product brief to validated implementation — with explicit handoffs, persistent state, and identity enforcement.

items.name: wave-planner
items.description: Transform project issues into execution-ready implementation plans with risk prediction, wave-based organization, and TDD workflow.

items.name: wave-planner-skill
items.description: Transform Linear project issues into execution-ready wave plans with risk prediction and specialist agent assignments. Orders work by risk, not readiness.

items.name: waves-exovian
items.description:
Waves is a product development framework that turns ideas into production software through a structured sequence of AI-driven artifacts. It provides the AI agent with persistent memory, project awareness, and a clear methodology — so every session starts informed, every task traces to a purpose, and every decision is recorded.

The framework guides the complete lifecycle: validate the idea (feasibility analysis with Monte Carlo and Bayesian projections and kill criteria), distill findings into validated facts (foundation), define what the product is and why it exists (blueprint with capabilities, flows, rules, and success metrics), plan delivery in organic cycles called waves (roadmaps with phases and milestones), track implementation per task (logbooks with objectives, scope, and completion guides), execute code aligned with project rules and business intent (objectives-implement), and document what was accomplished (resolutions).

Each artifact feeds the next. Each session picks up where the last one left off. The agent reads the blueprint before writing code, follows extracted coding rules, alerts when work doesn't align with the product definition, and preserves context so nothing is lost between sessions.

items.name: wayfinder-connector
items.description: Connect Claude to Frametric Wayfinder — the charity and nonprofit intelligence platform. Search, explore, and enrich data on 400,000+ organisations across 6 countries (England & Wales, US, Scotland, Ireland, Canada, Australia). Provides 6 tools: charity search, profile lookup, financial analysis, sector browsing, classification data, and benchmarking. Ideal for fundraisers, grant-makers, researchers, and anyone working with the nonprofit sector.

items.name: wealth-stack
items.description: AI-powered wealth management plugin for Indian investors. PMS/AIF analysis, NRI tax planning, family office advisory, goal-based SIPs, SEBI compliance.

items.name: web-ctl
items.description: Browser automation toolkit for AI agents — navigate, authenticate, and interact with web pages through a single CLI. Agents drive headless browsers to fill forms, click buttons, read content, and capture screenshots; when login or CAPTCHA is required, the browser opens for the human, the human completes auth, and control returns to headless mode (auth handoff). Persistent sessions survive across CLI invocations so the agent doesn't need to log in repeatedly. Built-in prompt-injection defense for content read from pages. Designed for tasks where the agent needs to interact with a real web app — testing flows, scraping behind a login, automating internal dashboards.

items.name: web-vitals-auditor
items.description: Run Lighthouse audits, diagnose Core Web Vitals regressions, and audit bundles, images, and fonts for performance wins.

items.name: webscan

items.name: webscanner
items.description: A webscanner plugin that performs automated client-side web security assessments. Point it at any domain and it produces a structured Markdown pentest report covering secrets exposure, vulnerable JS libraries, security misconfigurations, XSS sinks, CORS issues, and more with zero manual setup required.

items.name: website-quality-checker
items.description: Webpage quality evaluator based on Google Search Quality Rater Guidelines (QRG). Inspects page purpose, MC quality, E-E-A-T, reputation, and spam signals to produce a graded report (S/A/B/C/D).

items.name: wicked-garden
items.description:
Wicked Garden — AI-Native SDLC

A full software development lifecycle as a single Claude Code plugin. 14 domains, 80 specialist agents, 152 commands — covering everything from requirements through production operations.

What makes it different from a good CLAUDE.md: it's executable infrastructure, not passive guidance. Hooks enforce workflow gates before Claude sees your prompt. Context from memory, search, and project state is assembled automatically on
every turn. Decisions persist across sessions. Quality gates actually block progression when evidence is missing.

Works standalone with zero external dependencies. Local SQLite storage. No API keys, no cloud services, no setup beyond install.

Core systems:

- Crew — Signal-driven project workflows with 8 phases (clarify → design → build → test → review → operate), 7-dimension complexity scoring, hard-enforced quality gates, and multi-perspective consensus review for high-stakes decisions
- Smaht — Automatic context assembly on every prompt via 3-tier routing (hot/fast/slow). Surfaces relevant memories, code search results, kanban state, and crew context without you asking
- Mem — 3-tier persistent memory (working → episodic → semantic) with auto-consolidation, tag-based search, and access-frequency ranking. Decisions from month-old sessions surface when relevant
- Search — Code intelligence with symbol search, blast radius analysis, data lineage tracing, and service map discovery
- Jam — AI brainstorming with dynamic persona focus groups and multi-model council sessions using installed LLM CLIs (Codex, Gemini, Copilot)

Plus specialist agents for engineering, product, platform/DevSecOps, QE, data, delivery, agentic architecture, and on-demand personas.

items.name: wiki-knowledge-complier
items.description:
A. wiki-knowledge-compiler turns Claude Code into an AI-powered knowledge management system that:

B. Workflow
Ingest → Compile → Link → Query → Write-back → Improve

Each interaction improves your knowledge base over time - turning answers into reusable assets instead of one-off responses.

- Ingests raw sources (PDFs, markdown, notes, URL stubs) into an immutable archive.
- Extracts atomic concepts, creates summaries, and builds topic pages — all with provenance.
- Queries the knowledge base with citations and writes back reusable answers.
- Maintains structural health: detects orphans, duplicates, stale pages, and broken links.
- Synthesizes cross-cutting insights with explicit confidence ratings and uncertainty markers.
- Everything is plain markdown with YAML frontmatter. No databases, no cloud services, no proprietary formats.

The LLM agent handles all the summarizing, cross-referencing, and bookkeeping—so your knowledge base compounds and improves over time.
